slides.1.title: Key Points
slides.1.highlights.0.title: North–south divide
slides.1.highlights.0.content: The valley runs from around Vienne to around Avignon; northern and southern Rhône differ so much in climate, grapes and style that they are almost two regions
slides.1.highlights.1.title: From Roman times to the papal court
slides.1.highlights.1.content: Roman Vienne, the papacy's move to Avignon in 1309 and the origin of Châteauneuf-du-Pape
slides.1.highlights.2.title: Forerunner of the AOC system
slides.1.highlights.2.content: Baron Le Roy's 1923 rules at Châteauneuf-du-Pape foreshadowed the French AOC system
